summary: Keep one active Millennium Parking Garages concession, add InfraBridge-managed Global Infrastructure Fund I as the second current 50% owner alongside Northleaf's inferred 50%, and represent AMP as the predecessor manager through February 2, 2023 rather than as a separate current owner.
nonblockingDisclosureGaps: Northleaf's exact fund and SPV attribution and a direct primary-source confirmation of its inferred 50% stake are not publicly disclosed.
The original Morgan Stanley and LAZ economic split is not publicly disclosed.
Current 2026 occupancy and capital-expenditure metrics are not publicly disclosed.
recommendedActions: Retain one canonical Millennium Parking Garages, LLC concession record and do not split its four garages or holding entities into additional PortCos.
Add InfraBridge-managed Global Infrastructure Fund I as an active 50% owner from the February 2, 2023 manager succession.
Retain Northleaf as an active owner from the May 18, 2016 close with its 50% position identified as inferred rather than directly disclosed.
Represent AMP Capital as the predecessor manager of the same GIF I interest from May 18, 2016 through February 2, 2023 and preserve the Chicago Loop Parking and LMG2 concession history.
Exclude Ares, DigitalBridge, SoftBank, ArcLight, SP+/Metropolis, Next Parking and the City of Chicago from direct PortCo ownership.
